newsitem.title: USA: Border Capital sues Ariz., GTech over bingo patent.
newsitem.headline: Border Capital sues Ariz., GTech over bingo patent.

text.p: Border Capital Corp sued The Arizona Lottery and GTech Corp, alleging they infringed two Border patents for playing bingo offsite.

In papers filed Monday in the U.S. District Court in Delaware, Border said the Arizona lottery and its contractor, GTech, infringed patents '970 and '083 for "Methods and apparatus for playing bingo over a wide geographic area."
Also listed as plaintiffs are Border's Nevada subsidiary, IBC Investments Ltd, and Gaming Properties & Investments Inc.
The suit seeks unspecified triple damages for "willful infringement" and a court order blocking further alleged infringement.
No one at The Arizona Lottery was available for comment.
